title: TERRA INCOGNITA
summary: Material territories — scratches, light leaks, and the carrier as evidence. Build a passage from three recorded film surfaces with different visible defects. Establish a recognizable image before following a scratch or light boundary into the next fragment. Hold one surface to reveal the material carrier, return to a scene, and end on a blank interval with optical noise. Cut across 5 verified public-domain archival windows (39.5s) and audited across two Critic Tribunal rounds (v1 → v2).

transforms: phase: SURFACE 03 · THE CARRIER REVEALED (BLEACHED EMULSION)

Selected from Mirror of America (1963) at 0.33–6.13s because the gesture is complete inside a verified single-camera take with zero internal cuts.

transforms: phase: SCENE RETURN · WORLD SURFACING THROUGH DAMAGED CELLULOID

Selected from Mirror of America (1963) at 0.33–6.33s because the gesture is complete inside a verified single-camera take with zero internal cuts.

transforms: phase: CLOSING INTERVAL · LEADER & OPTICAL TRACK NOISE
shots.why: Laboratory Design for Microbiological Safety (1966): Blank leader interval held with 16mm optical carrier noise. Bridge: BLANK INTERVAL + CARRIER SOUND. reviews.text:
VERDICT: repair_required (Round 1 — v1 assembly audit)
Critic Role: Independent material-evidence critic

Observed Defects on v1 Proof Strip:
- Seg #05 (t=20.50s-28.50s): `c04eb5e1` shows a Geiger counter rather than damaged film carrier.
- Seg #06 (t=28.50s-34.50s): `d69a0d4b` shows an out-of-focus rotating dark shape rather than a recognizable world scene surfacing through grain.

Largest Gap:
Seg #05 and Seg #06 failed to show the material carrier defect and recognizable world scene surfacing through damaged emulsion.

Causal Hypothesis:
Unverified clip selection on `c04eb5e1` and `d69a0d4b`.

Falsifiable Repair Condition:
Replace Seg #05 with Cineosis human-verified damaged/bleached emulsion strip `497f7a8c` (`0.3s-6.2s`, `OBS: Very bright, washed-out figures move across a bleached frame`) and replace Seg #06 with human-verified grainy archival street scene `4d02a782` (`0.3s-6.3s`, `OBS: Grainy damaged footage shows vehicles and figures in an urban setting`).

Strength to Preserve:
The opening vertical scratch in `e0a5fa07`, the authored Carrier Bridge sprocket wipe (Seg #03), the wildfire flare in `b45f3dbf`, and the blank leader optical-track close in `8b5d40ae`.
